method.source_check: Both actual PNG SHA256 hashes checked against freeze ledger before extraction
method.extract: After compositing transparent RGBA on white, pixels with grayscale below 180; use 4 distinct vertical column-projection runs to isolate glyphs; each glyph cropped to tight ink bbox
method.normalization: Each glyph resized preserving native aspect ratio to exactly 254px ink height and centered in a common 324x300 pixel frame. No new or modified glyph strokes.
method.statistic: Binary mask intersection-over-union IoU. Symmetric mean Canny-edge distance in common pixel space. These quantify appearance, not aesthetic skill.
method.reference: One locally installed Noto Serif CJK SC Regular font, TTC index 2; no font file redistributed.

findings.measured: A and B differ in all four glyph silhouettes; smallest A/B difference is 影, largest is 舟. B is less similar to this one standard serif reference than A for all 4.
findings.not_measured: Professional taste, legal originality, typography source font identity, generalization to another wordmark, unprompted Chinese recognition
findings.professional_assessment: Insufficient causal or brand-specific rationale for which native stroke should change and why; visual variation is not proven superior professional design. Keep as METHOD_CANDIDATE_UNVALIDATED.

reviewer_package_contains_only: Two-stage self-transcription and aesthetic evaluation instructions
blind_review_readiness.note: The authoring assistant and conversation user have seen the alternatives and are not eligible to claim independent naive blind review. No actual third-party reviews solicited or submitted by this assistant.

limitations: This was a posthoc read of the two already seen images, not a prospective, source-blind comparison.
Comparing to a single Noto reference does not identify the actual font source or certify originality.
IoU is sensitive to glyph crop and rasterization/threshold and normalization; it cannot be promoted to professional aesthetic evaluation.
Variation over four letters from separately generated images cannot causally attribute specific improvements to a learned designer method.
The comparison panel has reviewer-masking and blind-public mapping commitment, but independent human responses remain zero.
next_gate: Only after truly independent reviewers write their exact four-character reading before brand brief, and then give an unbiased brand preference, unmask and compare. Even a favorable one-wordmark preference cannot validate transfer to unknown words. Pause new repeated font sampling.
